cues.text: С утра я снова спешу на работу
In the morning, I rush to work again
Кофе в руке, Телефон в кармане
Coffee in my hand, My phone in my pocket
Весь день я смотрю на часы
All day, I keep looking at the clock
Но список дел всё ещё длинный
But my to-do list is still long
And I just want some quiet
But my friends are already waiting
I don’t want to cancel our plans
Я не хочу жить только работой
I don’t want to live only for work
I need some time for myself
My work is important to me
Но жизнь не заканчивается в шесть
But life doesn’t end at six
I want to have time to live
On Saturday, I’ll turn off my laptop
I’ll meet the people close to me
I’ll pick up my guitar again
And play a couple of songs
Then I’ll go for a short run
I know I need to work
Но я не хочу каждый день
But I don’t want every day
I need time to slow down
Я не хочу жить только работой
I don’t want to live only for work
I need some time for myself
My work is important to me
Но у меня есть жизнь за её пределами
But I have a life outside of it
I want to have time to live
And remember what matters to me
